_doc: [OPUS-4.8] sq-bzign. Per-arm REFERENCE query a competent agent writes for each task. Arm A = the gold plain SPARQL; arm B = its K:<name> terse rewrite (legend card carried); arm C = B plus V("phrase") where the task resolves a concept. The harness transpiles B/C through the real terse-expand example and grades all three against the gold answer-set. Frozen with PREREG.md.
